objective: test the smallest authorized depth increase by preserving the validated layer-30 v4 patch exactly and adding one independently selected exact-ternary layer-29 MLP patch

candidate.rationale: layer 29 is adjacent and immediately upstream of validated layer 30, so the experiment adds exactly one layer while end-to-end evaluation exposes their strongest local interaction
candidate.all_other_tensors: byte-identical to the frozen BF16 GGUF parent

layer29_training.activation_source: BF16 teacher MLP inputs and outputs from the frozen 48-row cache
layer29_training.artifact_selection: minimum validation normalized reconstruction loss across exact hard artifacts, including step-zero direct PTQ
layer29_training.patch_merge: the new three-tensor layer-29 patch and exact retained three-tensor layer-30 patch must be disjoint and merge to exactly six tensors

controls.one_layer_v4: exact retained layer-30 CPU-QAT v4 CQ3 GGUF
controls.direct_ptq_two_layer: the layer-29 and layer-30 MLP triplets quantized directly from BF16 to CQ3_0 without training
controls.candidate_two_layer: new held-out-selected layer-29 patch plus byte-exact retained v4 layer-30 patch, packed to CQ3_0

mandatory_evaluation.independent_reconstruction: layer 29 on the same 12 sealed rows across all six tasks
mandatory_evaluation.larger_capability: the frozen 64-row five-shot subject-balanced MMLU replication after quick gates pass
mandatory_evaluation.invalid_run_rule: missing, partial, context-failed, or infrastructure-failed reports are invalid, never zero

decision_rules.training_value: layer-29 candidate must improve independent-test normalized reconstruction loss by at least 10 percent relative to direct PTQ
decision_rules.exact_scope: exactly six target tensors are CQ3_0, all 435 non-target tensors are byte-identical across BF16, direct PTQ, and candidate, and layer-30 patch SHA-256 remains the frozen v4 value before packing
decision_rules.cute: candidate must score at least 6/20, lose at most one item versus one-layer v4, and score at least direct two-layer PTQ
decision_rules.math500: candidate must score at least 5/8 and at least direct two-layer PTQ
decision_rules.code: candidate must score at least 4/6 and at least direct two-layer PTQ
decision_rules.wikitext: candidate perplexity must be no greater than direct two-layer PTQ and no greater than 8.7729, which is one-layer v4 plus 0.10
decision_rules.mmlu: candidate must score at least direct two-layer PTQ, lose at most three items versus BF16, and lose at most two items versus one-layer v4
decision_rules.next_scope: only if every rule passes may a separately preregistered experiment add exactly one third MLP layer; broad or whole-model depth expansion remains forbidden

claim_boundary: an exactly two-MLP-layer Qwen3.5-4B CPU-QAT depth rung; not whole-model ternary training, not Qwen3.8-27B, and not a breakthrough
